info.name: Oracle Cloud My Services Service Entitlements Resource API
Returns a Service Entitlement resource collection, default ordering is "id:asc".

params.name: domain
params.description: The identity domain name or the IDCS GUID of the resource

params.name: ids
params.description: Filter on a list of ids

params.name: limit
params.description: Limits the number of resources to return

params.name: offset
params.description: Starting offset of the resources to return

params.name: orderBy
params.description: Ordering of the resources, this resource can be ordered by id, modifiedOn, createdOn

params.name: serviceDefinitionNames
params.description: Filter on a list of service definition names

params.name: statuses
params.description: Filter on a list of statuses

items.docs: Returns a Service Entitlement resource collection, default ordering is "id:asc"
